items.q: What should you remember about **IMO AI shock**?
items.a: **4/6 original olympiad problems** solved by Google AI; more than Loh can do.

items.q: What should you remember about **Creativity alone insufficient**?
items.a: **AI may surpass human** creativity; synthesis on novelty is the human edge.

items.q: What should you remember about **Interview = synthesis test**?
items.a: **wait for "never seen** this" signal, give hints, measure synthesis speed.

items.q: What should you remember about **Writing homework = exercise**?
items.a: **AI school writing = zero** mental fitness; language skills critical because LLM power is language.

items.q: What should you remember about **Grade don't do**?
items.a: **think like teacher; evaluate** AI outputs; school trained execution, world needs verification.

items.q: What should you remember about **Test prep steals invention**?
items.a: **cram every strange question** → no surprise → no inventing.

items.q: What should you remember about **Competition → depression**?
items.a: **brilliant students depressed; life** as outdoing others never satisfies.

items.q: What should you remember about **Make others happy**?
items.a: **addictive at scale; correlates** with traditional success; philosophy before tactics.

items.q: What should you remember about **Delight others to survive AGI**?
items.a: **team-up imperative; value-creator vibe or excluded from opportunity.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Simulate the world**?
items.a: **empathy + AI research** to build internal models; entrepreneur superpower.

items.q: What should you remember about **AI steals taste/truth**?
items.a: **personal expression lost; agenda** deception if you can't think critically.

items.q: What should you remember about **5 AI providers ≠ 7.5B viewpoints**?
items.a: **seek diverse media; AI** sounds complete but may be one-sided.
